info.description:
Machine-readable description of the seventy-eight live R231 calculation contracts. This DOCUMENT REVISION identifies the contract set; runtime availability is independently verified at the public gateway. Call the public Node gateway, not the internal Python service.

API keys are server-side credentials. Bearer and x-api-key are alternatives, and dashboard cookies are not calculation credentials. Named keys can be restricted to one calculation scope or astro:*, can expire, and are shown only once at creation.

Charts require a known civil time, valid IANA timezone, dates from 1800-01-01 through 2200-12-31, and valid coordinates. Tropical remains the default; supported sidereal ayanamsas are Lahiri, Raman, Krishnamurti, Fagan–Bradley, Yukteshwar, Sassanian, True Chitra, True Revati, True Pushya, Galactic Center at 0 Sagittarius, and Galactic Alignment/Mardyks. The birth-time-sensitivity workflow may instead receive an explicitly unknown or approximate time; it returns sampled stability only and never invents an exact chart.

Vargas supports D1/D2/D3/D4/D5/D6/D7/D8/D9/D10/D11/D12/D16/D20/D24/D27/D30/D40/D45/D60/D81/D108/D144/D150. Vimshottari retains its two-level default and supports optional depth 3 and 4. The Ashtakavarga contract returns unreduced seven-planet Bhinnashtakavarga, contributor Prastara, and their 337-point Sarvashtakavarga sum, with explicit opt-in reductions and pindas and no interpretation or prediction. These are bounded calculation conventions, not a complete Jyotish system or practitioner validation.

The additive calculation suite includes fixed-reference Equal/Whole Sign house-ingress search, a unified event calendar, relationship SVG wheels, fact-linked natal HTML, sampled birth-time sensitivity, two-axis chart robustness, no-guess chart-input readiness, no-substitution 25-system house readiness, unweighted 24-system planet-house stability, bounded multi-policy aspect admission configurable natal aspect/midpoint/pattern analysis, and classical unequal planetary hours. Pattern, planetary-hour and house-ingress outputs are geometric or conventional classifications without interpretation, ranking, or advice.

Generated SVG, PNG, and HTML are bounded, contain no scripts or remote resources, and accept no caller markup or URLs. Astrocartography can return opt-in deterministic RFC 7946 GeoJSON, OGC KML 2.2, GPX 1.1, and SVG/PNG with a default coordinate grid or explicit bundled public-domain Natural Earth 1:110m coastlines, without remote map requests, geocoding, ranking, or interpretation. Birth-time sensitivity is sampled, non-exhaustive, and not rectification. The six-star-only route uses an immutable CC0-derived catalog independently compared with Astropy/ERFA. Minor-body calculations are not contracted or shipped. Numerology adds bounded Pythagorean date/name arithmetic with explicit master-number and Y rules, traceable sums, and an optional explicit calendar year; no interpretations, predictions, scientific-validation claim, or practitioner approval.

Monthly usage resets by UTC calendar month. Every attempt reaching atomic reservation consumes one unit, including invalid input, dependency failures, and timeouts. There is no automatic refund or public idempotency mechanism; do not blindly retry.

post.summary: Render a deterministic natal/transit double wheel
post.description:
Returns an original 1200 by 1120 SVG in JSON. Natal houses are inside; requested transit positions are outside. Opt-in include_png returns a deterministic metadata-free PNG derived from the same internal SVG; omission or false preserves the predecessor response exactly. No uploaded markup, image, font or URL is accepted. failed or timed-out admitted attempts are not refunded.
Historical mode uses an explicit BCE/CE date object and UT1 conventions. Its response is the versioned historical envelope, not the modern UTC envelope. Read result for calculation fields and metadata for limits and uncertainty.

include_svg.description: When true, returns a deterministic 1200x800 Cosmic Ephemeris-owned coordinate-grid SVG map. Omission or false preserves the predecessor geometry response exactly.

basemap.description: Requires include_svg true. Natural Earth adds a bundled public-domain 1:110m coastline with pinned provenance; no tiles, network calls, navigation accuracy, boundaries, geocoding or change to angular geometry. Omission preserves the predecessor output.

include_png.description: When true, also returns a deterministic PNG derived from the returned SVG. Requires include_svg true.

include_geojson.description: When true, returns a deterministic RFC 7946 FeatureCollection with four ordered features per body. Independent of SVG/PNG export.

include_geojson_seq.description: When true, returns a deterministic RFC 8142 GeoJSON Text Sequence with four ordered Feature records per body. Independent of every other export.

include_ndjson.description: When true, returns deterministic newline-delimited compact RFC 7946 Feature records in body/angle order. Independent of every other export.

include_topojson.description: When true, returns deterministic unquantized TopoJSON with one named GeometryCollection, a central arc inventory, and exact authoritative coordinates. Independent of every other export.

include_kml.description: When true, returns a deterministic OGC KML 2.2 artifact with four ordered placemarks per body, fixed integrity metadata, and exact authoritative coordinates. Independent of GeoJSON and SVG/PNG export.

include_gpx.description: When true, returns a deterministic GPX 1.1 artifact with four ordered tracks per body, preserved date-line track segments, fixed integrity metadata, and exact authoritative coordinates. Independent of GeoJSON, KML, and SVG/PNG export.

include_csv.description: When true, returns a deterministic RFC 4180 CSV artifact with one fixed-column row per authoritative geometry point in body, MC, IC, ascendant, descendant, segment, and point order. Independent of every other export.

include_wkt.description: When true, returns one deterministic WKT GEOMETRYCOLLECTION with four ordered geometries per body and preserved date-line segments. Independent of every other export.

include_wkb.description: When true, returns one deterministic OGC WKB 1.x little-endian GEOMETRYCOLLECTION with four ordered geometries per body and preserved date-line segments. Independent of every other export.

include_gml.description: When true, returns one deterministic GML 3.2 MultiGeometry in CRS84 with four ordered geometries per body and preserved date-line segments. Independent of every other export.
